text:
Stop getting comfortable. It's costing you her.

Rules every man needs to hear:

1. Your love is unconditional. Hers is not. Accept that.
2. She fell for the builder in you. Not the man on the couch.
3. The day you stop growing is the day her feelings start fading.
4. This isn't cruel. This is how attraction has always worked.
5. She doesn't owe you forever just because she chose you once.

You earned her attention once. Now earn it every day.

Comfort kills attraction. Growth keeps it alive.
caption:
The discipline and mindset that saves your dating life has nothing to do with tricks. Self improvement is the only real strategy. Stop coasting.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
